critique: Ran cleanly as an operator-supervised Phase-1 read-only audit. Strengths: the two-phase gate held (zero writes in Phase 1), the grounding mandate forced live artifact checks (file existence, CLAUDE.md line count, PR #899 merge state, deadline-date arithmetic) instead of age-inference, and the self-critique checklist mapped 1:1 to the actual failure modes. The three-list output (CONTRADICTIONS/STALE-SUSPECT/RULE-CANDIDATES) was the right shape. Gaps surfaced by the run: (1) The prompt frames CONTRADICTIONS as MEMORY.md-internal, but the real live contradiction was MEMORY.md-vs-Hindsight (a correction landed in the .md file while the stale Hindsight fact still recalls at score ~1.03). The prompt should explicitly ask for cross-store contradictions, not just intra-file ones. (2) RULE-CANDIDATES step assumes un-promoted corrections; in a mature system every recurring correction was ALREADY a rule, so the useful finding is 'confirm landed,' not 'create.' The prompt could add a LANDED classification to avoid implying new rules are needed. (3) The Hindsight recall returned ~20 near-duplicate facts for a single pending decision (Three-Types) -- recall de-duplication or a note that bank duplication is itself a drift signal would help. (4) Cap guidance ('<=3KB per call, delegate large reads') collided with the recall returning ~33KB payloads that a PostToolUse hook auto-spilled to disk; the prompt's cap advice is sound but the tool ignores it, so the prompt should tell the operator to expect spill-to-disk and extract via subagent. Highest-value real finding this run: the Three-Types decision is 10 days past its 2026-07-06 deadline and resolved-by-default to the 80-line version (CLAUDE.md is 81 lines live), yet still sits in the STILL-OPEN block -- exactly the stale-load-bearing-pointer drift this prompt exists to catch.
one_change: Add a CROSS-STORE contradiction check (MEMORY.md correction vs still-live Hindsight fact) and a LANDED classification to RULE-CANDIDATES, so the prompt distinguishes 'promote this' from 'confirm this already landed' and catches stale facts the .md already superseded but the bank still recalls.
